installer.Automatically retry once with a fresh Fo: Automatically retry once with a fresh Foundry name when Azure confirms a deleted-account naming conflict (enabled by default).
installer.If a deleted Foundry account blocks this: If a deleted Foundry account blocks this installation, a new name generation will be saved and retried once. No existing account is restored, deleted or purged; sufficient quota is still required.
installer.Azure confirmed a deleted Foundry accoun: Azure confirmed a deleted Foundry account name. Saving a fresh name generation and retrying infrastructure once; existing accounts remain untouched.
installer.Failure details were read automatically: Failure details were read automatically from this deployment's Azure operations.
installer.Additional failure details could not be: Additional failure details could not be verified for this attempt; the original error is preserved.
installer.Create a new Foundry account name for a: Create a new Foundry account name for a clean installation; preserve the saved name generation for normal retries.
installer.A new Foundry account name will be gener: A new Foundry account name will be generated after approval and saved for retries. Existing Foundry accounts are not deleted; web app and resource group names stay unchanged.
installer.FOUNDRY_NAME_SALT must be empty or 32 lo: FOUNDRY_NAME_SALT must be empty or 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters
installer.Saved Foundry name generation could not: Saved Foundry name generation could not be read safely; no new Azure deployment was started.
installer.A fresh Foundry name generation is saved: A fresh Foundry name generation is saved for this environment. Reuse it for retries; changing it again creates another account.
installer.ARM confirms the project, but Foundry re: ARM confirms the project, but Foundry reports Project not found (404). Waiting for project availability; no role is granted for this response.
installer.Waiting for Foundry project availability: Waiting for Foundry project availability ({elapsed}s elapsed, attempt {attempt}/40); domain restrictions remain enforced.
installer.Foundry still reports Project not found: Foundry still reports Project not found after the bounded wait, although the ARM project was verified. Check Foundry provisioning and endpoint availability before retrying; nothing was deleted.
installer.If Foundry denies agent configuration (4: If Foundry denies agent configuration (403), the installer will verify its SDK identity and grant that identity Foundry User only on this project, then wait up to 10 minutes. This requires roleAssignments/write (Owner, or User Access Administrator plus resource read). No broader role or domain-filter fallback will be used.
installer.Foundry returned 403. Verifying the inst: Foundry returned 403. Verifying the installing SDK identity and exact project before repairing access.
installer.Cannot safely bind the SDK identity, sub: Cannot safely bind the SDK identity, subscription tenant and Foundry project. No role was granted. Verify the selected subscription, tenant and project endpoint, then retry.
installer.The installer cannot manage project acce: The installer cannot manage project access. Ask an administrator with roleAssignments/write (Owner, or User Access Administrator plus resource read) to grant this installing identity Foundry User on the exact project. No broader role was requested.
installer.An existing role assignment is condition: An existing role assignment is conditional or conflicts with the expected identity, role or scope. Ask an administrator to review it; the installer did not replace it or broaden access.
installer.Project access could not be confirmed. C: Project access could not be confirmed. Check project IAM before retrying; no duplicate assignment was submitted.
installer.Foundry User is confirmed for the instal: Foundry User is confirmed for the installing identity on project {scope}.
installer.Waiting for project access propagation (: Waiting for project access propagation ({elapsed}s elapsed, attempt {attempt}/40); domain restrictions remain enforced.
installer.Foundry still denies configuration after: Foundry still denies configuration after the bounded access wait. Check project IAM and tenant policies, then resume deployment; no broader role or unfiltered agent was attempted.
installer.Foundry configuration time budget expire: Foundry configuration time budget expired; no further request was submitted.
installer.Recovery report: no Azure resources were: Recovery report: no Azure resources were automatically restored, deleted or purged; the diagnostic commands below were not executed.
installer.Validated interactive answers remain loc: Validated interactive answers remain local defaults until --reset-wizard. Bing terms and final approval are always requested again; credentials and consent are not saved.
installer.Provisioning had not started in this att: Provisioning had not started in this attempt. No Azure resources were created by this attempt; pre-existing resources are unchanged.
installer.Default: keep the resources and diagnose: Default: keep the resources and diagnose the failure. Remote operations can continue after a local failure or interruption. Wait until they reach a terminal state before retrying.
installer.A deployment conflict was reported. Insp: A deployment conflict was reported. Inspect the current parent and Foundry deployment operations and timestamps; wait for the active operation to finish rather than deleting resources or starting another deployment.
installer.A soft-deleted Foundry account may reser: A soft-deleted Foundry account may reserve the name. Ask an administrator to inspect and restore the matching account when appropriate. The installer never purges soft-deleted accounts automatically.
installer.Resolve the reported quota or capacity i: Resolve the reported quota or capacity issue before retrying: request quota, reduce the selected capacity, or select a supported model/region. Deleting resources is not a general quota fix.
installer.Verify sign-in, subscription tenant and: Verify sign-in, subscription tenant and project IAM with an administrator. After access is corrected and propagated, resume deployment; do not broaden roles or remove domain restrictions.
installer.Infrastructure outputs were confirmed in: Infrastructure outputs were confirmed in this attempt. After correcting the failure and checking that no deployment is still active, resume agent/settings/application deployment without reprovisioning:
installer.Confirmed outputs are not available for: Confirmed outputs are not available for a safe deployment-only resume at this phase. Diagnose first, then rerun the interactive installer using the retained defaults and fresh approval.
installer.Read-only PowerShell diagnostics (not ex: Read-only PowerShell diagnostics (not executed). Inventories are evidence, NOT deletion lists:
installer.Resource names not confirmed by current: Resource names not confirmed by current outputs and the installation prefix are unknown; do not infer ownership from names, tags or the create-resource-group option.
installer.Current confirmed installation resources: Current confirmed installation resources: web app {web}; Foundry account {account}; project {project}.
installer.Optional clean-slate recovery requires s: Optional clean-slate recovery requires separate explicit approval, backups and verified exclusive ownership. Only consider the dedicated web app and Foundry resources. Delete the dedicated Foundry project first; remove the model deployment child if required, then delete the account. Account deletion must not be assumed to cascade to the project. Consider the App Service plan only if unused by every other app. Agent, model and plan names require inspection. Never delete an existing resource group wholesale.
installer.Search/Blob mode only: separately verify: Search/Blob mode only: separately verify the optional Search service {search} and Storage account {storage}. Deleting them loses indexed content and stored documents; require backups and explicit data-loss approval first.
installer.Foundry could not authenticate the insta: Foundry could not authenticate the installing identity. Check Azure sign-in and tenant, then retry.
installer.Foundry denied agent configuration (HTTP: Foundry denied agent configuration (HTTP 403). Verify that the installing identity has Foundry User or equivalent agents/write permission on the project, and allow role assignments to propagate before retrying.
installer.Foundry could not configure the filtered: Foundry could not configure the filtered agent. Inspect service diagnostics; the domain restriction was not relaxed.
installer.Model capacity is the initial request th: Model capacity is the initial request throughput quota, not the number of users, guaranteed performance, or a cost budget. Azure validates quota at deployment.
installer.Local installation interrupted. Remote o: Local installation interrupted. Remote operations may continue; nothing was cancelled or deleted in Azure. Check deployment operations before retrying.
installer.This is limited context, not a confirmed: This is limited context, not a confirmed root cause. Read the deployment operation details with these read-only commands; no diagnostic command was executed:
installer.Displayed capacity: {capacity}. Enter ke: Displayed capacity: {capacity}. Enter keeps it; examples never replace a valid saved value. An Azure default is not a recommendation for your workload.
installer.Test/POC example: 10 units for a few man: Test/POC example: 10 units for a few manual queries with low concurrency.
installer.Production example: 100 units only as an: Production example: 100 units only as an illustrative starting point, not guaranteed capacity.
installer.The {units}-unit example is not applicab: The {units}-unit example is not applicable to the returned SKU range; it is not a suggested input.
installer.For Standard/GlobalStandard/DataZoneStan: For Standard/GlobalStandard/DataZoneStandard, capacity allocates throughput quota, not maximum users, a monthly budget or a fixed PAYG bill. Production sizing needs peak requests/minute, context size, model TPM/RPM ratios and limited simultaneous work.
installer.Conditional example only: IF 1 unit = 1,: Conditional example only: IF 1 unit = 1,000 TPM and 1 RPM, 10 requests/minute x 6,000 estimated rate-limit tokens/request require max(60, 10) = 60 units; 25% margin gives 75, and 100 offers headroom. This is NOT a conversion for the selected model. Rate-limit estimates differ from billed tokens; verify actual model ratios, increments and available quota. Apply only within the returned SKU range.
installer.This SKU does not use the Standard PAYG: This SKU does not use the Standard PAYG examples. Reserved/provisioned capacity has different capacity-based charges; Batch uses different quota semantics. Follow provider bounds and your organization's sizing and pricing guidance; no arbitrary test/production value is recommended.
